definitions: Any of a large class of organic compounds with a characteristic molecular structure containing four rings of carbon atoms.
Any of a group of hormones having the steroid basic structure, such as the adrenal cortical hormones, sex hormones, and anabolic steroids.
A synthetic steroid hormone, especially an anabolic steroid, used to increase muscle mass or enhance athletic performance.
examples: The doctor prescribed a steroid for the inflammation.
Many athletes have been banned for using steroids.
Steroids can have significant side effects.
